output.question: Where can I find Coca-Cola's latest annual report?
output.answer: The Coca-Cola Company's latest annual report is its Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, filed on February 20, 2026. You can get it from the Annual Filings (10-K) page on Coca-Cola's investor relations site (https://investors.coca-colacompany.com/filings-reports/annual-filings-10-k), which lists it first, or open the HTML filing directly at https://investors.coca-colacompany.com/filings-reports/all-sec-filings/content/0001628280-26-010047/ko-20251231.htm. It is also on SEC EDGAR under CIK 0000021344, accession number 0001628280-26-010047. The FY2026 report is not due until about February 2027, so as of November 2026 this is still the latest one.

key_facts.fact: Coca-Cola's most recent 10-K, labeled 'Form 10-K: Annual report', is dated 02/20/26 and has 192 pages. It is listed first on the company's Annual Filings (10-K) page.

SEC EDGAR shows the most recent Coca-Cola Co 10-K was filed on 2026-02-20, with accession number 0001628280-26-010047. The one before it was filed on 2025-02-20.
